pipeline_preflight.rights_boundary: ITU Q.23/Q.24 may be cited and paraphrased; do not reproduce their prose, Table A-1, or Figure 1. Draw a new keypad matrix from the verified numeric mapping.

writer_scope.single_move: Turn finite Fourier evidence at the eight DTMF frequencies into an explicit, falsifiable row-plus-column decision with declared tolerance, rejection, timing, and cost contracts.
must_establish: A symbol contains one simultaneous low-group tone and one simultaneous high-group tone; the decision is structured and is not merely the two largest magnitudes.
Finite observation replaces ideal spectral lines by shifted window responses, so off-grid tones leak and a strong tone can hide a weaker neighbor.
The selected AT&T column of Q.24 Annex A is a named laboratory profile, not a universal ITU receiver table.
Frequency, level/twist, duration, pause, interruption, and exactly-one-per-group checks are separate gates with an explicit reject output.
The detector, impairment grid, threshold table, latency origin, cost units, and accuracy denominator must be frozen before any performance result or confusion matrix is published.
must_not_claim: Do not call the supplied synthetic FIR/audio a deployed receiver, a real acoustic recording, a reverberant path, or evidence about clipping; none of those artifacts is present.
Do not call 25 ms a mandatory AT&T reject. It lies between that profile's 23 ms non-operation maximum and 40 ms operation minimum.
Do not claim the 99%/95% target has been met; no 10 dB corpus, frozen receiver, threshold table, impairment grid, or confusion matrix exists.
Do not equate a noninteger-frequency Goertzel/resonator output with an integer DFT bin, and do not compare real and complex operation counts as one unnamed total.
Do not infer that zero padding narrows the physical record-window main lobe or supplies missing observation time.
Do not treat Orfanidis's approximately 30-sample high-versus-low group separation estimate as a Q.24 signal-duration acceptance rule.

frozen_inherited_conventions.sampled_time: x[n] is a sampled sequence; at f_s=8000 Hz, T_s=125 microseconds and n is dimensionless.
frozen_inherited_conventions.frequency: f is in hertz, omega=2*pi*f/f_s is in radians/sample, and the N-point bin center is f_k=k*f_s/N.
frozen_inherited_conventions.order: Natural DFT storage is k=0,...,N-1; for real x[n], negative-frequency partners occur at N-k and must not be mistaken for a second DTMF component.
frozen_inherited_conventions.selected_frequency: C(f)=sum_{n=0}^{N-1} x[n] exp(-j*2*pi*f*n/f_s) evaluates the finite-record DTFT at physical frequency f. It equals X[k] only when f=k*f_s/N under the same record and scale.
frozen_inherited_conventions.window: Unless explicitly changed, the finite frame is a length-N rectangular observation. Its first zeros around a complex sinusoid are one f_s/N away; null-to-null main-lobe width is 2*f_s/N.
frozen_inherited_conventions.twist: Define twist as 20*log10(A_high/A_low) dB, matching the generator's amplitude ratio and the Q.24 AT&T high-versus-low power-level wording.
frozen_inherited_conventions.latency: State whether latency is measured from source onset, received-signal onset, frame boundary, or last required sample; include frame alignment/hop and channel delay separately.

verified_standard_and_source_claims.claim: DTMF uses low frequencies 697, 770, 852, 941 Hz and high frequencies 1209, 1336, 1477, 1633 Hz; one simultaneous tone from each group gives 16 symbols.
locators: Official ITU-T Q.23 (11/1988), printed p. 2, clauses 5-6; https://www.itu.int/rec/dologin_pub.asp?id=T-REC-Q.23-198811-I%21%21PDF-E&lang=e&type=items

verified_standard_and_source_claims.claim: Each transmitted frequency is within +/-1.8% of nominal and total harmonic/intermodulation products are at least 20 dB below the fundamentals.
verified_standard_and_source_claims.result: verified as a sender requirement, not a receiver pass band
verified_standard_and_source_claims.locator: Official ITU-T Q.23 (11/1988), printed p. 2, clauses 7.1-7.2

verified_standard_and_source_claims.claim: The receiver checks for simultaneous presence of one and only one frequency from the high group and one and only one from the low group.
verified_standard_and_source_claims.locator: Official ITU-T Q.24 (11/1988), printed p. 1, clause 2.2; https://www.itu.int/rec/dologin_pub.asp?id=T-REC-Q.24-198811-I%21%21PDF-E&lang=e&type=items

verified_standard_and_source_claims.claim: Q.24 identifies fundamental receiver parameters but recognizes varying national/application values; Annex A tabulates adopted examples.
verified_standard_and_source_claims.locator: Official ITU-T Q.24, printed p. 1, introduction and clause 2.1

verified_standard_and_source_claims.claim: In the AT&T column of Annex A: operate for absolute frequency offset <=1.5%, non-operate for offset >=3.5%, accept high-minus-low level difference from -8 dB through +4 dB, operation duration minimum 40 ms, non-operation duration maximum 23 ms, pause minimum 40 ms, interruption maximum 10 ms, and signaling velocity minimum 93 ms/digit.
verified_standard_and_source_claims.result: verified as the named AT&T profile only
verified_standard_and_source_claims.locator: Official ITU-T Q.24, printed p. 3, Table A-1 and footnote b

verified_standard_and_source_claims.claim: A DTMF receiver can evaluate the finite-record DTFT at the four low and four high frequencies, choose a thresholded pair, and decode that pair; selective evaluation or Goertzel can avoid computing unused spectral coordinates.
Finite windowing broadens lines into main lobes and sidelobes; a weak component can be hidden under leakage from a stronger nearby component.

For real input, Lyons's single-output Goertzel ledger uses N+2 real multiplications and 2N+1 real additions; integer m is DFT-bin equivalent, while the resonant variable may be noninteger for arbitrary-frequency evaluation.
Lyons gives a multiplication-efficiency rule M<log2(N) for M Goertzel tones versus a standard radix-2 FFT.
verified_standard_and_source_claims.result: verified but does not establish an eight-tone win here: 8>log2(205)=7.679; after padding to 256, 8=log2(256), not strictly less

verified_standard_and_source_claims.claim: A two-pole resonator centered on a target DTMF column grows more selective as pole radius approaches one, while a practical choice must preserve stability and acceptable settling.
verified_standard_and_source_claims.result: verified with correction: poles at radius r are BIBO-stable for every r<1; 'too close to one' means long settling/large ringing, not mathematical instability until r reaches one
verified_standard_and_source_claims.locator: research/texts/mit6003-s2.txt lines 5790-5879, Problem Set 6 Engineering Problem 6 and solution pp. 9-11

verified_standard_and_source_claims.claim: Orfanidis's rectangular-window estimate f_s/(1209-941) is about 30 samples at 8 kHz for separating the low and high groups.
verified_standard_and_source_claims.result: verified as a spectral group-separation estimate only; it is not enough to identify adjacent tones inside a group and is not a conformance duration

n205_key5_bins.reproduction: For each f, compute k=round(f*N/f_s), f_k=k*f_s/N, and 100*(f_k-f)/f.
n205_key5_bins.guardrail: This compares bin centers with a tolerance interval; it does not prove a detector accepts all tones in that interval. The +1.5% 1336-Hz tone is 1356.04 Hz and is nearer N=205 bin 35 than bin 34.

tolerance_intervals.guardrail: A tone 'exactly between decision bands' is undefined until band edges and tie/reject behavior are declared. For +/-1.5% bands, use a point in the open gap and require reject; do not silently use nearest-nominal classification.

duration_and_latency.finding: A single N=205 frame is shorter than the 320 received samples required by the selected 40 ms operation boundary. The interval after 23 ms and before 40 ms is deliberately neither must-operate nor must-reject under the table; 25 ms lies in it.
duration_and_latency.latency_guardrail: A <=40 ms decision claim has no slack if it also promises the AT&T 40 ms minimum-duration qualification. Define onset and sample-boundary convention; any hop/frame alignment adds delay. The supplied FIR adds 50 samples=6.25 ms of linear-phase group delay if latency is measured from source rather than receiver input.

rectangular_window.qualification: These are normalized complex-exponential Dirichlet-envelope values at the nominal analysis frequency. A real dual-tone record also contains conjugate-frequency cross terms and phase dependence.

largest_two_counterexamples.real_signal_symmetry: For the committed N=205 clean key-5 tone frame, the two largest magnitudes over all 205 bins are k=34 and k=171, both the +/-1336-Hz component; they are conjugate partners, not row and column.
largest_two_counterexamples.lone_tone_positive_bins: For x[n]=cos(2*pi*770*n/8000), n=0,...,204, the largest positive-frequency bins are k=20 (magnitude 91.1826663) and k=19 (32.9147712), both leakage from the one low-group tone. A two-largest-positive-bins rule is therefore also invalid.
largest_two_counterexamples.required_decision: Search each group separately, require a declared dominance/energy condition, require exactly one valid member in each group, and include reject.

forward_half_bin_case.reproduction: For a unit complex tone at bin 20.5, evaluate |sin(pi*d)/(N*sin(pi*d/N))| at d=1.5. A weak exact-bin complex line has normalized magnitude 0.01.
forward_half_bin_case.guardrail: The exercise must state real versus complex signal, weak-line bin/separation, relative phase, window, and normalization. Without those, 'neighboring' has no unique numeric result.

n205_mixed_radix_historical_cooley_tukey.warning: This historical unit is not interchangeable with the separate product/add or Goertzel real-arithmetic ledgers.

n256_padded_radix2.warning: The transform evaluates the 256-point grid, not the 205-point grid or the exact nominal DTMF frequencies.

operation_ledgers.finding: No exact strategy winner is verified until the exercise freezes the frequency coordinates and one implementation/cost ledger. The predecessor lesson's valid comparison uses eight selected X_256[k_i] sums versus the same padded FFT bins; exact nominal matched-frequency outputs are a different comparison.

corpus_reproducibility.python_contract: pure stdlib, f_s=8000 Hz, 16-bit mono WAV, fixed LCG seed 0x6D2B79F5
corpus_reproducibility.result: All regenerated files, including phone-channel-ir.csv, matched the committed files byte-for-byte by SHA-256/cmp.

corpus_signal_contract.single_key_clean: 50 ms silence + 100 ms tone + 50 ms silence; 1600 samples total
corpus_signal_contract.all_keys_clean: 16*(100 ms tone + 100 ms pause)=25600 samples=3.2 s
corpus_signal_contract.channel_output: 25700 samples=3.2125 s because full 101-tap convolution adds 100 samples
corpus_signal_contract.pcm_saturation_check: Zero samples equal either 16-bit saturation endpoint in every committed WAV. The largest measured absolute sample is 0.904721 in the +4 dB twist file; the corpus does not exercise clipping.
corpus_signal_contract.noise_files: The 30 dB and 15 dB names refer to power averaged over the full alternating tone-plus-pause sequence; the generator resets the same LCG seed for every noise variant.
corpus_signal_contract.guardrail: Declare whether SNR is measured over active tones or the whole sequence. The supplied file named 15 dB is about 18 dB on active tone samples because pauses are included in the generator's signal-power average. It is not evidence for the brief's 10 dB target.

synthetic_phone_channel.construction: 101-tap symmetric Hamming-windowed difference of ideal lowpasses at 300 and 3400 Hz
synthetic_phone_channel.finding: The supplied FIR is essentially flat over all DTMF frequencies and contributes delay, but almost no inter-group twist. It is a deterministic course-designed telephone-band idealization, not a recorded channel. Q.24 itself does not specify this exact 300-3400 Hz FIR.

feature_only_smoke_check.method: On each known tone onset, take a 320-sample rectangular frame; compute eight exact-nominal unscaled complex correlations; choose the largest low and largest high magnitude. For channel files, start 50 samples later.
feature_only_smoke_check.negative_control: The same argmax-only method maps the +3.5% must-not-operate file to key 8 and maps the 25 ms file to key 5. Therefore these are feature sanity checks, not a conforming receiver or accuracy evidence; explicit tolerance and duration gates are indispensable.

exercise_preflight.evidence: The N=205 bin table is recomputed above.
exercise_preflight.guardrail: Ask whether each nearest bin center lies inside the named AT&T +/-1.5% interval; do not say this verifies receiver operation at the tolerance edge.

exercise_preflight.evidence: AT&T gives a <=23 ms non-operation side and >=40 ms operation side; zero amplitude violates exactly-one-per-group; +/-1.5% bands have open gaps.
exercise_preflight.guardrail: Use <=23 ms for a mandatory reject example or label 25 ms indeterminate. Specify decision-band edges and tie behavior for the between-bands tone.

exercise_preflight.evidence: Both real-signal conjugate symmetry and the lone-770-Hz positive-bin calculation give deterministic counterexamples.
exercise_preflight.guardrail: State whether 'largest two' ranges over all bins or positive bins; provide the matching counterexample.

exercise_preflight.missing: receiver code, thresholds, 10 dB data/generator contract, impairment grid, trial count, label set including reject, class balance, SNR reference, latency origin, and confusion-matrix normalization
Whether both paths compute N=205 bins, N=256 padded bins, or exact nominal frequencies; Goertzel variant; operation units; the claimed seeded 12-key set and its expected reject cases.
exercise_preflight.continuity_guardrail: The prerequisite compares eight selected 256-grid sums with a padded 256-point FFT. If this lesson changes to exact nominal frequencies, say so and do not claim coefficient identity with ordinary FFT bins. The committed corpus has 16 keys, while a 12-key subset must explicitly exclude A-D.

exercise_preflight.evidence: At N=205 a half-bin offset is 19.512195 Hz; rectangular leakage 1.5 bins away is -13.4641 dB, 26.5359 dB above a -40 dB weak complex line.
exercise_preflight.guardrail: Freeze weak-line separation, phase, real/complex convention, window, and plotted normalization, then hand off window choice rather than solving the next lesson.

blockers.detail: manifest.json and the filename label key5-short-25ms-must-reject.wav as mandatory reject, but the selected AT&T profile guarantees non-operation only through 23 ms and operation from 40 ms. Twenty-five milliseconds is in the unspecified transition region.
blockers.required_resolution: Regenerate/rename the mandatory reject fixture at <=23 ms, or relabel 25 ms as indeterminate and exclude it from conformance accuracy. Do not write around this contradiction in prose.

blockers.detail: The brief's >=99% clean and >=95% at 10 dB with +/-1.5% offset has no frozen receiver, thresholds, 10 dB corpus, seeded grid, trial count, confusion matrix, or accuracy definition.
blockers.required_resolution: Freeze and run the executable protocol before drafting any result language. Until then present 99%/95% only as a prospective acceptance target.

blockers.detail: N=205 observes 25.625 ms, while the named operation-duration minimum is 40 ms. A <=40 ms decision leaves no frame-alignment slack, and source-to-decision latency would also include the synthetic channel's 6.25 ms group delay.
blockers.required_resolution: Define received-onset versus source-onset latency, qualification duration, frame/hop schedule, and decision sample. Use N=205 only as a feature/cost frame unless a temporal state machine aggregates at least 320 received samples.

blockers.detail: An ordinary full FFT returns grid coordinates. Exact matched-frequency/Goertzel evaluations at 697/.../1633 Hz are generally off that grid. N=205, padded N=256, and exact nominal evaluations cannot be called identical coefficients.
blockers.required_resolution: Choose one common coordinate set and one cost ledger. If exact nominal correlations are desired, compare decision behavior rather than complex coefficient identity, or specify interpolation/CZT and count it.

blockers.detail: No seeded 12-key impairment set or expected pass/reject manifest exists. The committed deterministic sequence contains all 16 keys, including service keys A-D.
blockers.required_resolution: Create a declared 12-key subset/order, seed, impairment cases, rejection labels, and expected decisions, or explicitly use the existing 16-key corpus.

blockers.detail: The application calls the artifact deployed/real loudspeaker-microphone or a supplied recording, while the supplied baseline is synthesized audio through a flat DTMF-band FIR. No real recording, reverb, clipping, speech, dial tone, echo, or browser capture is committed.
blockers.required_resolution: Describe the baseline as synthetic and narrow the claims, or source/record the promised real-channel artifact with provenance and a separate test contract.

blockers.detail: Noise is scaled from power over the full sequence including 100 ms pauses. The file named 15 dB measures about 17.97 dB over active tone samples, so its label is not interchangeable with an active-tone SNR threshold.
blockers.required_resolution: Freeze the SNR measurement interval and regenerate the test grid accordingly; report both if sequence-level and active-tone SNR are useful.

blockers.detail: Argmax row/column features classify supplied positive examples but also emit keys for the +3.5% reject and short-duration cases. Absolute energy, group dominance, twist, detuning, duration, pause/interruption, and invalid-pair logic are not specified.
blockers.required_resolution: Freeze every gate, its units, inclusive boundary, state-machine behavior, and reject label; then test positive, gray-zone, and negative controls separately.

writer_guardrails: Name the selected receiver profile every time exact +/-1.5%, +/-3.5%, -8/+4 dB, 23/40 ms, 40 ms pause, or 10 ms interruption values appear: they are the AT&T column of Q.24 Annex A.
Keep Q.23's +/-1.8% sender tolerance distinct from the AT&T receiver operate/non-operate bands.
Treat 23-40 ms as a gray region. A conforming implementation may choose local behavior there, but the lesson may not relabel it as a normative must-pass or must-reject zone.

Give the detector an explicit reject output. A lone tone, two same-group tones, a gap frequency, out-of-band detuning, insufficient duration, or failed dominance/twist threshold must never be forced to the nearest key.
Separate spectral evidence from temporal qualification: an N=205 magnitude frame can contribute evidence, but it cannot by itself prove 40 ms duration.

When comparing FFT and Goertzel/matched correlations, write the actual frequency in every sum and keep real multiplications, real additions, complex products, complex additions, and historical multiply-adds in separate ledgers.

For performance results, freeze seed, PRNG update, phase distribution, independent low/high offsets, twist distribution, signal level, channel placement, noise placement and SNR interval, duration distribution, class balance, rejects, and trial count.
Accuracy must name the denominator and label set. With only 16 clean-key trials, >=99% means 16/16; with only 12, it means 12/12. Do not imply statistical confidence from one sequence.
The current noise variants reuse the same LCG sequence at different scales; do not present them as independent Monte Carlo trials.
Call the 101-tap filter a synthetic 300-3400 Hz course channel. Its measured gain varies by less than about 0.013 dB across DTMF frequencies, so it does not meaningfully test twist distortion.
Do not reproduce ITU figures or Table A-1. Paraphrase the selected values with exact clause/table attribution and draw original rights-safe diagrams.
The next lesson owns window selection. This lesson may expose the half-bin/-40 dB failure and name leakage, but must hand the repair to windows-leakage-and-resolution with a Ref.
